author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Don't waste your time doing LLM eval until the bean counters complain you spend too much money on tokens. 

Your time is a limited resource, you can either stick to the best (most expensive) LLM to push the boundary on what AI agents could do, or spend your time trying to optimize for the cost of running it on cheaper LLMs.   

Premature optimization killed many good projects and companies.
